title: Notion rejects a paragraph or text property longer than 2000 characters with body failed validation
symptoms: Sync of long emails or transcripts into Notion fails only for long records
cause: Each rich text object caps text.content at 2000 characters, and link URLs at 2000 too. The cap applies per object, so one long string in a single object fails even though the block could hold more.
fix: Split long strings into several rich text objects of at most 2000 characters. The rich_text array holds at most 100 items, so very long text needs several blocks.
apply:
const chunks = text.match(/[\s\S]{1,2000}/g) ?? [];
const rich_text = chunks.map(c => ({ type: "text", text: { content: c } }));
affected: Notion REST API, all versions, as of 2026-10
